goal: Make campaign schema and record upgrades explicit without inventing legacy reference coverage
asset: Existing packet input closure and shared safe tightening precondition
scope: Legacy reference lock diagnostics and record compatibility

record.question: How should newer compilers and recorders handle contracts and identities from an in-flight older campaign?

options.strongest_objection: Historical reference bytes cannot gain provenance retroactively; the coverage gap must stay visible
A plugin update prevents recording completed work even when packet bytes and obligations still match

record.rationale: Refuse ineffective guard schemas before launch. Permit exact historical packet identities for recording only with an explicit uncovered-reference statement; retain operator unpinned allowances.
evidence: Issue181 reproductions show unchanged archives called edited and old schemas compile without emitted-guard fields

evidence: Existing packet hashes and recorder Evidence are reusable

requirements.statement: Old schema fields required by emitted guards fail compilation with migration context; genuine legacy identities can be recorded with explicit missing-reference coverage and explicit unpinned allowances
